name: 48202 · Detroit, MI
findings: ZIP 48202 (Detroit) has 274 nonprofit organizations. 134 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 104 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (10% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48202 (Detroit) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
39% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48202 (Detroit) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 58 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
